title: Network Configuration Guide
content:
## Network Setup

### Basic Network Configuration
1. Open Control Panel > Network
2. Configure network interface:
   - Set IP address (static or DHCP)
   - Configure DNS servers
   - Set default gateway

### Remote Access Setup
#### DDNS (Dynamic DNS)
1. Enable DDNS service
2. Choose a DDNS provider
3. Configure hostname and credentials
4. Test connection

#### VPN Setup
1. Install VPN Server package
2. Configure VPN protocols:
   - OpenVPN: Most compatible
   - PPTP: Easy setup, less secure
   - L2TP/IPSec: Good balance
3. Set up user accounts
4. Configure firewall rules

#### Port Forwarding
1. Access your router settings
2. Forward ports to NAS IP:
   - Port 5000: HTTP
   - Port 5001: HTTPS
   - Port 1194: OpenVPN
3. Test external access

### Firewall Configuration
- Enable built-in firewall
- Create rules for specific services
- Block suspicious IPs
- Enable auto-block for failed logins
